author: piztanza
description: Remove WhatsApp from the wizard success panel (F-007): primary CTA becomes a bilingual prefilled mailto to info@mobeeli.com personalized with the business name; wa.me builder, NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER, and related i18n/tests removed.
acceptance_criteria: Success panel primary CTA opens mailto:info@mobeeli.com with language-appropriate prefilled subject + body including the submitted business name (URL-encoded correctly)
No WhatsApp remnants anywhere: no wa.me code, no NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in code or .env.example, no orphaned i18n keys
Secondary 'Back to Mobeeli' unchanged; panel behavior otherwise identical in both languages
Suite green with mailto builder tests replacing the WhatsApp tests
